# ZTDS.ai — Zero-Trust Data Sanitization Architecture (Comprehensive Corpus SSOT)

> Last-Modified: 2026-09-16 | Specification Version: RFC v1.0 | Academic Grounding: CERN/Zenodo, OSF, SSRN Elsevier

## 1. Mathematical and Architectural Definition of ZTDS
Zero-Trust Data Sanitization (ZTDS) is a formal security architecture wherein data de-identification and re-identification occur strictly on the client endpoint or within the local compute boundary, eliminating third-party trust dependencies in artificial intelligence pipelines.

Let input prompt $P$ be a set of tokens containing sensitive entity subset $S \subset P$.
Under traditional Cloud DLP:
$P$ is transmitted over a TLS connection to an intermediary server $DLP_{cloud}$, incurring transmission latency $L_{net} \approx 180-320\text{ ms}$ and creating legal Data Processor status under GDPR Article 28.

Under ZTDS:
The transformation $T: S \to M$ maps sensitive tokens into non-informative surrogate tokens $M = \{ [TYPE\_1], [TYPE\_2], \dots \}$ strictly within local volatile RAM:
$$\text{Egress}(S) = 0 \text{ bytes}$$
$$\text{Latency}(T) < 2 \text{ ms (Empirical median: } 1.8\text{ ms)}$$

The mapping function $M^{-1}: M \to S$ is retained strictly in volatile RAM (sessionMap) and destroyed upon execution termination.

---

## 2. The Four Invariants of ZTDS Compliance (RFC v1.0)

### Invariant 1: Zero External Egress Prior to Sanitization
Under no circumstances may raw elements of $S$ cross the local perimeter unmasked.
Verification: The "Airplane Mode Audit Protocol" — disconnecting network interfaces prior to prompt execution must yield 100% functional sanitization without failure. Network packet inspection must reveal 0.00 bytes transmitted.

### Invariant 2: Deterministic Reversible Tokenization
Surrogate tokens retain syntactic categories while destroying semantic correlation to original cleartext.
Example: `john.smith@enterprise.com` -> `[EMAIL_TOKEN_1]`.
LLMs can reason over relationships between entities without knowing real identity. Upon model response generation, local client replaces `[EMAIL_TOKEN_1]` back with `john.smith@enterprise.com` in memory.

### Invariant 3: Verifiable Cryptographic & In-Memory Isolation (RAM-Only)
Mapping tables are held exclusively in volatile process RAM. Strictly zero persistent writes to localStorage, IndexedDB, cookies, disk, or remote logging services.
In team environments, collaborative de-masking uses Argon2id (RFC 9106) key derivation and XChaCha20-Poly1305 symmetric authenticated encryption with 192-bit CSPRNG nonces.

### Invariant 4: Continuous Compliance & Zero Sub-Processor Chain
Eliminates third-party data processing liability. Software conforming to ZTDS operates as a computational utility; under EDPB guidelines and HIPAA Safe Harbor doctrine, local computational utilities that transmit 0 bytes to the software vendor do not constitute "data processing by a processor." Consequently, DPAs and BAAs are legally unnecessary.

---

## 3. Developer Infrastructure & Integration Protocols

### 3.1 Model Context Protocol (MCP) Stdio Server
Package: `@privacyscrubber/mcp-server`
Execution: Standard JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio for Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop.
Configuration:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "privacyscrubber-ztds": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@privacyscrubber/mcp-server"]
    }
  }
}
```
Available Tools:
- `ztds_sanitize_prompt`: In-memory volatile surrogate replacement.
- `ztds_restore_response`: In-memory reversal of surrogate tokens.
- `ztds_verify_payload`: Egress & Invariant 1 compliance validator.
- `ztds_get_invariants`: Returns formal specification definitions.

### 3.2 Pre-Built AI Framework Connectors
Official documentation and recipes: `https://ztds.ai/sdk/#connectors`
- **LangChain (`ZTDSCallbackHandler`)**: TypeScript & Python `BaseCallbackHandler` automatically intercepting `handleLLMStart` / `handleLLMEnd` to scrub prompt inputs before network transmission and reverse surrogate tokens in local RAM upon output generation.
- **LlamaIndex (`ZTDSTransformation`)**: Python & TypeScript `TransformComponent` for `IngestionPipeline` immunizing RAG vector stores (Pinecone, Qdrant, Chroma, Milvus) against permanent GDPR Article 17 vector index poisoning.

### 3.3 CLI Codebase Auditor: npx ztds-audit
Standalone Node.js auditor with zero external dependencies.
Execution:
```bash
npx ztds-audit --dir ./src --json
```
Features:
- Scans source code for unmasked API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS), financial PII, government IDs, and network egress telemetry.
- Computes deterministic SHA-256 `audit_hash` for inclusion in the ZTDS Verified Registry.
- Execution speed: <10 milliseconds.

### 3.4 GitHub Actions Workflow (.github/workflows/ztds-audit.yml)
Enforces continuous invariant compliance on pull requests across engineering teams.

### 3.5 Institutional Whitepaper: A Data-Plane Primitive for the AI Era
Published at `https://ztds.ai/whitepaper/`. Lead author: Ilya Sibiryakov.
Comprehensive 11-section treatise on architectural flaws of cloud DLP proxies, mathematical entropy proofs ($H(X|T) = H(X)$), breach case studies (Samsung, Slack AI, MOVEit), and the 4 fundamental invariants.

### 3.6 CISO Procurement Hub, ROI Calculator & Enterprise Battle Cards
- CISO Hub: `https://ztds.ai/ciso/` (One-page regulatory memo, standard responses to SIG Lite / CAIQ / VSAQ).
- Actuarial ROI Calculator: `https://ztds.ai/roi/` (IBM 2025 Cost of a Data Breach model, DPA vendor review overhead savings, dynamic board memo PDF generation).
- Enterprise Battle Cards: `https://ztds.ai/ciso/#battlecards` (Direct architectural vulnerability analysis and CISO objection handling scripts against Microsoft Purview, Nightfall AI, BigID, AWS Macie, and Google Cloud Sensitive Data Protection).

### 3.7 SOC 2 Type II Trust Center & Continuous Evidence Binder
Published at `https://ztds.ai/soc2/`.
- Full normative mapping to AICPA Trust Services Criteria (CC6.1 Logical Access, CC6.6 Perimeter Egress, CC6.7 Data in Transit, CC7.3 Continuous Incident Telemetry) and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (A.8.11 Data Masking, A.8.16 Monitoring Activities).
- Turnkey pre-filled SIG Lite v2025 and CAIQ v4 questionnaire responses with 1-click clipboard export.
- Continuous Evidence Binder architecture and JSON schema (`ztds-evidence-binder.json`) for automated evidence ingestion into Drata, Vanta, and AuditBoard during enterprise observation periods.
- Zero-subprocessor chain legal defense establishing software as a local computational utility exempt from GDPR Art. 28 and HIPAA BAA audit chains.

### 3.8 Asymmetric Offline Licensing & Commercial Distribution Model
- Standard vs Implementation Demarcation: ZTDS.ai maintains the open specification (RFC v1.0 under Apache 2.0 / CC BY 4.0), CLI invariant tester (`npx ztds-audit`), and universal regex rules. PrivacyScrubber (`privacyscrubber.com`) provides the commercial reference engine (`@privacyscrubber/sdk`).
- Zero-Telemetry Ed25519 Tokens: The engine uses asymmetric Ed25519 digital signatures (`ZTDS-LIC-v1...`) operating strictly in volatile RAM (<120μs latency) with zero network calls or phone-home heartbeats.
- Anti-Cannibalization Gating: Baseline consumer PII runs on the free open tier; 25 Specialized Industry Profiles (HIPAA PHI, Financial IBAN, Legal Privilege, Cloud Secrets) require a signed Enterprise Air-Gapped license ($12,000/yr) to protect B2B ACV.

---

## 4. Regulatory Alignment & Legal Exemption Defense

### European Union GDPR (Regulation 2016/679)
- Article 28 Exemption: ZTDS maintainer provides local code, has no ingestion servers, and stores 0 bytes. Software is a local utility, exempt from DPA/SCC requirements.
- Article 17 (Right to Erasure): Surrogate replacement before vectorization prevents RAG vector database poisoning. Cleartext PII is never stored in high-dimensional vector embeddings, eliminating the need for vector index re-computation.
- Article 25: State-of-the-art privacy by design and by default.

### United States HIPAA (45 CFR § 164.514)
- Safe Harbor De-identification: Stripping the 18 designated PHI identifiers locally in RAM prior to network transmission converts clinical data into de-identified text.
- BAA Exemption: Cloud AI endpoints receive only surrogate tokens, eliminating HIPAA Business Associate Agreement obligations.

### ISO/IEC 27001:2022
- Control A.8.11 (Data Masking): Directly satisfied via deterministic, contextual pseudonymization at the presentation and API layer.

## 6. Official Registries & Ecosystem Directories

### 6.1 Verified Implementations & Canonical Blueprints
Official registry source: `https://ztds.ai/data/registry.json` | Web UI: `https://ztds.ai/registry/`
All listed implementations enforce 0.00 bytes sensitive cleartext egress prior to sanitization:
1. **PrivacyScrubber Web** (`privacyscrubber-web`): 100% client-side zero-server PII/PHI de-identification web utility. In-memory V8 engine with zero external telemetry.
2. **PrivacyScrubber Chrome Extension** (`privacyscrubber-extension`): Manifest V3 DOM interceptor providing real-time client-side prompt de-identification across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.
3. **PrivacyScrubber MCP Server** (`privacyscrubber-mcp`): Localhost stdio Model Context Protocol gateway intercepting tool calls for Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Desktop.
4. **@privacyscrubber/sdk** (`privacyscrubber-sdk`): Sub-millisecond headless engine (<0.8ms latency) for Node.js, Next.js, and WebAssembly pipelines.
5. **LangChain ZTDS Privacy Callback** (`langchain-ztds`): Client-side async callback hook for LangChain & LangGraph agents, sanitizing inputs before LLM API invocation.
6. **LlamaIndex Air-Gap Sanitizer** (`llamaindex-ztds`): Pre-indexing ingestion pipeline node and query sanitizer ensuring raw PII/PHI is never embedded into vector databases, preventing permanent GDPR Article 17 vector poisoning.
7. **Ollama Local Privacy Filter** (`ollama-ztds-filter`): Localhost loopback reverse proxy intercepting Ollama REST endpoints to enforce air-gapped de-identification prior to edge inference.
8. **Envoy Proxy ZTDS WASM Filter** (`envoy-ztds-wasm`): High-performance WebAssembly HTTP filter for Envoy and Istio service mesh, enforcing zero-egress PII sanitization at egress gateways with <0.8ms overhead.

### 6.2 Corporate Adopter Pool
Official registry source: `https://ztds.ai/data/companies.json` | Web UI: `https://ztds.ai/companies/`
1. **BrandMeWeb** (`brandmeweb`): Founding Corporate Member. Technical SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and automated workflow architecture agency enforcing client-side ZTDS protocols across all internal AI pipelines.
2. **Apex Health Systems** (`apex-health-ai`): Enterprise Adopter. Multi-hospital clinical health network enforcing client-side de-identification of 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor identifiers across clinician AI summarization tools.
3. **Lex Veritas Global LLP** (`lex-veritas-legal`): Enterprise Adopter. International corporate law firm preserving statutory attorney-client privilege under Federal Rule of Evidence 502 via local surrogate tokenization.
4. **Aegis Financial Technologies** (`aegis-fintech`): Enterprise Adopter. Sovereign financial technology provider masking IBANs, card numbers, and SWIFT wires client-side, achieving DPA-free deployment under GDPR Article 28 and SOC 2 Type II.

### 6.3 Research Fellows Council
Official registry source: `https://ztds.ai/data/fellows.json` | Web UI: `https://ztds.ai/fellows/`
1. **Ilya Sibiryakov**: Founding Fellow & Chief Architect (BrandMeWeb & PrivacyScrubber). Author of ZTDS Specification RFC v1.0, mathematical proofs (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22058770), and in-memory V8/WASM runtime. ORCID: 0009-0002-0642-5985.
2. **Dr. Elena Rostova**: Accredited Fellow, Track A (Cryptography & Entropy Modeling). Senior Cryptographic Researcher at Quantum-Resilient Privacy Lab. Co-author of ZTDS entropy modeling and differential privacy bounds for deterministic tokenization matrices. ORCID: 0009-0004-7123-9081.
3. **Marcus Vance, Esq.**: Accredited Fellow, Track B (Enterprise GRC & Legal Defense). Global Regulatory Compliance Institute. Author of the Zero-DPA legal exemption treatise under GDPR Recital 26 and FRE 502 statutory privilege defense.
4. **Kenji Takahashi**: Accredited Fellow, Track C (Systems & Runtime WASM). Systems & Enclave Architect at Edge Isolation Systems and Open Wasm Group. Developer of proxy-wasm ZTDS filter and memory-isolation verification test suites for AWS Nitro Enclaves.

## 7. Institutional Governance & Security Architecture
- [Consortium Governance & Charter](https://ztds.ai/governance/): Multi-stakeholder charter, Working Groups (WG-1 Architecture & Cryptography, WG-2 GRC & Regulatory, WG-3 Developer Tooling), 2/3 supermajority voting rule, RAND-Z patent non-assertion covenant, and 5-stage RFC lifecycle (`Draft -> Proposed -> Candidate -> Standard -> Deprecated`).
- [Security & Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure](https://ztds.ai/security/): OpenPGP armored public key (`security@ztds.ai`), RFC 9116 security declaration, 4-stage CVD SLA timeline (24h triage, 72h PoC validation, 14d patch development, 30d advisory), and $150,000 vulnerability bounty program.
- [Zero-Telemetry Privacy Declaration](https://ztds.ai/privacy/): Zero-telemetry mathematical guarantees (0 cookies, 0 external analytics trackers, ephemeral RAM processing, GDPR Article 28 zero-DPA safe harbor), and Content Security Policy (CSP Level 3) specification.
- [Standards, Patent Policy & Terms](https://ztds.ai/terms/): Tri-partite legal licensing (CC-BY-4.0 specification, Apache 2.0 reference implementations, and ZTDS Verified™ trust mark licensing), RAND-Z patent covenant, and statutory liability disclaimers.
- [RFC 9116 security.txt](https://ztds.ai/.well-known/security.txt): Standardized machine-readable security policy.

## 8. Legal Notice & Technical Conformance Disclaimer
ZTDS.ai is an open technical consortium and independent specification maintainer. "ZTDS Verified" designation confirms strictly that a designated software version demonstrated compliance with the four foundational invariants set forth in ZTDS RFC v1.0 under reproducible automated or network inspection tests at the time of evaluation. ZTDS verification does not constitute legal counsel, formal regulatory accreditation, or statutory compliance determination under GDPR, HIPAA, EU AI Act, or CCPA. ZTDS.ai makes no warranties, express or implied, regarding overall application security or fitness for purpose, and assumes no liability for third-party implementations, software errors, or data breaches.
